com.vector.cfg.persistency.groovy.api

Interface IModuleApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @PublishedFilter(value=MsrPlatform.class)
public interface IModuleApi
    The IModuleApi API provides methods which allow to specify a filter.
    To specify a filter for the module configurations to import use one of the methods:
    • module(DefRef) Use a single DefRef
    • module(List) Use a list of AsrPath, DefRef or Definition Refs as String
    • module(AsrPath) Use a single AsrPath
    • module(String) Use a single Definition Ref as String

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.
